definitions.explanation: A refined or literary way to describe food or drink that tastes excellent.

examples.japanese: {美味|びみ}な⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{堪能|たんのう}→堪能：12081_tannou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美味|びみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんで→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please enjoy the fine flavors of this region.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{美味|びみ}な⟦{一品|いっぴん}→一品：08919_ippin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}しています→提供する：21736_teikyousuru⟧。
examples.english: We serve exquisite dishes using seasonal ingredients.

notes:
A literary and refined way to say delicious. Used more in writing, menus, and food descriptions than in everyday conversation. Can function as a noun (meaning delicious food/a delicacy) or as a na-adjective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美味|びみ}な⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ — delicious cuisine
- {美味|びみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{堪能|たんのう}→堪能：12081_tannou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to savor a delicacy
- {美味|びみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わう→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧ — to savor fine food
- ⟦{珍味|ちんみ}→珍味：05752_chinmi⟧{美味|びみ} — rare delicacies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- おいしい — delicious (everyday, most common)
- {美味|おい}しい — delicious (same kanji, colloquial reading)
- ⟦{絶品|ぜっぴん}→絶品：13811_zeppin⟧ — superb dish, masterpiece (stronger praise)
- {旨|うま}い — delicious, tasty (informal)

REGISTER:
More formal and literary than おいしい. Often seen in restaurant descriptions, food writing, travel brochures, and formal dining contexts.
